title: Atomic‐Scale Insights Into the Thermal Stability of High‐Entropy Nanoalloys

recollection.mechanism: guess: diffusion and segregation of elements
recollection.results: guess: improved thermal stability and unique properties

score.note: The thermal treatment is only generically inferred from the title. The recollection correctly anticipates segregation/core–shell formation, but gives no element-specific detail. Diffusion and segregation are directionally correct, though it misses the surface-energy-driven, kinetically controlled mechanism and reshaping-enhanced diffusion. The claimed improved stability is opposite to the observed poor stability, and no quantitative results such as heating to 973 K or 22% size reduction are recalled.
